integrity.euler_basis: Euler characteristic of a complex projective variety with an algebraic C-star action equals that of its fixed locus; constructible additivity then yields the exact-rank values.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for alg-geom/9611025 lists version 1 on 1996-11-20.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A diagonal one-parameter subgroup with pairwise distinct symmetric-coordinate weights has exactly the diagonal rank-one and off-diagonal rank-two coordinate points as projective fixed points.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The bibliographic record for Ilic--Landsberg lists primary MSC 14M12.
integrity.same_object_basis: Ilic--Landsberg explicitly define projective rank-at-most-r symmetric matrix loci; Hosono--Takagi study the same symmetric determinantal family.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns projective symmetric determinantal loci, not generic rectangular or skew-symmetric rank loci.
Only Euler characteristic is determined; vanishing on an exact-rank stratum does not imply vanishing of its cohomology.
The fixed-point argument is short, so an older or unindexed source may contain the same stabilization observation.
title: Euler characteristic stabilizes at rank two in symmetric determinantal towers
